name: @supauth/sdk-typescript
description: TypeScript SDK for the SupaOAuth Management API and public sign-in experience APIs

scripts.clean: bun -e "const fs = await import('node:fs/promises'); await fs.rm('dist', { recursive: true, force: true });"
scripts.build: bun run clean && bunx tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.typecheck: bunx tsc --noEmit && bunx tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && bunx tsc -p tsconfig.tooling.json
scripts.typecheck:contracts: bunx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.contracts.json && bunx tsc -p tsconfig.consumer.json && bunx tsc -p tsconfig.worker.json
